notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We already announced we've partnered with Erabit Studios for global publishing.[/p][p]Erabit is known for publishing innovative indie games and supporting passionate developers.[/p][p]With their help, Replicat will reach new heights![/p][p]And on the development side, I've been adding new stuff to Replicat and have been fixing bugs.[/p][p]I updated the Playtest Version with these updates, after testing them on the Playtest Version, I will update the Demo Version too.[/p][p][/p][h3]Major Changes:[/h3][p][b]- Reworked "same color hand" curios:[/b][/p][p]I changed the curios that trigger when "all cards in your hand are the same color". Now they trigger when "at least 3 pairs are the same color". Their effects are slightly nerfed.[/p][p]Affected curios: Eye Candy, Melthand Device, Roman Candles, Nyan Bat[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Added End Game Stats[/b]: You see these stats when you beat or lose the game. Stats include:[/p][p]	- Total Moves Made[/p][p]	- Total Turns Used[/p][p]	- Total Points Scored[/p][p]	- Total Money Earned[/p][p]	- Total Money Spent[/p][p]	- Number of Cards Burned[/p][p]	- Total Number of Shop Rerolls[/p][p]	- Number of Super Purrs Achieved[/p][p]	- Total Number of Mismatches[/p][p]	- Curios Purchased[/p][p]	- No of essences used[/p][p][/p][p][b]- Big Picture Deck Mode:[/b] Added a button in deck view which displays a detailed screen where you can see all your cards and curios together. People have been asking for this when they beat the game, they want to send a screenshot showing the score but also what cards and curios they have in their deck.[/p][p][/p][h3]Minor changes:[/h3][p]- Added , between thousands. Now instead of "1000000", you'll see "1,000,000" in the score[/p][p]- Added scientific notation if the score is higher than 1 billion. notes.title: Playtest Update #8
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Cat Crew! 😸[/p][p]I’ve just rolled out a [b]major Beta Update[/b] for Replicat!
This update is currently [b]only available on the "Replicat Beta" branch[/b]. If you want to join the playtest, hop into [url="https://discord.gg/x3TEz2bNHW"]Replicat Discord[/url] and apply for access![/p][p]This Beta version is where I experiment with fresh mechanics, cards, and curio. So expect to see some half-baked ideas and temporary art as I iterate and playtest. Your feedback is [i]super[/i] important right now![/p][h2]🛒 New Feature: Item Locking in the Shop![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482125/b25fb213c25ae086436e51e69bc52ccb3bf3347f.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now [b]lock shop items[/b] to save them for future visits!
Just drag and drop your favorite items into the locking circle, and they’ll stick around for your next trip to the shop. (But beware: their price will go up by [b]+25% each round[/b] you keep them locked!)[/p][h2]🐱‍👓 Introducing 3 New Curios![/h2][p]These new curios interact with the item locking mechanic in fun ways:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Skeleton Key[/b]:
If you lock an item for 5 rounds, it’s automatically added to your deck![/p][/*][*][p][b]Music Vault[/b]:
Lets you lock [i]two[/i] shop items at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fruitful Tree[/b]:
Locked items get [b]10% cheaper[/b] each round they’re locked![/p][/*][/olist][h2]🐾 Balancing Notes[/h2][p]After a few runs, it seems like locking items makes the game a bit easier. To balance things out, [b]once you lock an item, you can’t get rid of it unless you buy it[/b]. This keeps the mechanic from being too powerful, but I’m open to your suggestions![/p][h2]🎷 We Want Your Feedback![/h2][p]What do you think about the new item locking system and curios?
Is it too easy, too hard, or just right?
Let us know in the comments or over on [url="https://discord.gg/x3TEz2bNHW"]Discord[/url]![/p][p]Thanks for helping us make Replicat the best jazzy cat deckbuilder out there!
Happy matching, and may the meows be ever in your favor! 🐾[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/x3TEz2bNHW" style="button"]Replicat Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Replicat Major Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just rolled out a new update for Replicat, and I’m excited to share what’s new!

🎮 Controller Support (Alpha)
The headline feature for this update is controller support! You can now kick back and play Replicat from start to finish with your favorite gamepad. This is an alpha version—it’s fully functional, but not yet perfectly polished. For the best UX, I’ll need to revisit and tweak the UI specifically for gamepad mode in a future update. For now, it’s all about letting you enjoy Replicat from the comfort of your couch!

Steam Deck: Controller support should also work on Steam Deck, though I haven’t been able to test it myself. If you try it out, I’d love to hear your feedback! Some players have mentioned the game already works well with touch—now you can choose whichever control style you prefer.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Alongside controller support, this update includes a bunch of minor bug fixes to make your gameplay smoother.

🎉 June Is a Huge Month for Replicat!
🗓️ Upcoming Events
TurnBasedThursday Fest (June 2nd): Replicat will be featured alongside awesome titles like Baldur’s Gate 3 and Clair Obscur: Expedition 33!

Best Indie Games Showcase (June 3rd): I’m thrilled for Replicat to be part of this event—fingers crossed for some extra visibility!

Steam Next Fest (June 9th): The big one! I’ll be working hard to fix bugs and listen to all your feedback during the festival.

Thank you all for your support and feedback—it’s what helps Replicat grow and improve. Please try out the new controller support and let me know what you think, especially if you’re playing on Steam Deck!

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you at the festivals!
Let’s make June a purrfect month for Replicat! 🐱✨

Wishlist, play, and share your feedback!

notes.title: Playtest Update #7
notes.notes:
Well, we are getting close to a demo build. I still have some more bugs and quality of life updates I need to make.
But I think the game is approaching to a state where I can release a demo and reach out to bigger youtubers.
So this probably means I will take some actions around making the Playtest version private.
Also in this version, you will realize I am adding some roguelike "unlocking" mechanics. So, not all of the cards and curios will be available at the beginning.
And after you lose or win a run, you will earn experience and you will unlock cards and curios when you level up.
In later levels, you might see some cards and curios you didn't see before. They were already in the game but because I disabled the experience system, you didn't see some of them before.

I also tried to test and fix a bunch of stuff regarding saving/loading but because of the nature of the game, there are so many edge cases which are introducing bugs.
Please keep me informed about the bugs and we'll make sure the demo version will be robust.

After I get the demo version out and convinced that it has not too many bugs, I will focus on improving the game.
Adding more cards and curios, more modifiers, some neat features like "locking a curio", seeing the collection of curios in a wider UI, etc...

I'll also be creating a new channel on our discord to get started with the localization. I very much appreciate anyone who would like to translate the game to their native language. If you are interested, here's a discord invite: [url=https://discord.gg/6HMpgT8mXC]https://discord.gg/6HMpgT8mXC[/url]

notes.title: Playtest Update #4
notes.notes:
Hi hi hi!
Quite big update here.

First of all game has been doing great. A few small youtubers played the game and people on discord have been reporting bugs, destroying the game. Overflowing the int!?!?! Really? I played the game 1000 times and haven't managed to do that!

Of course I fixed many many bugs, but let's start with the most important update:

[h2]THE PLAYTEST TOOL[/h2]

[url=https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/c4ef5b88bd5e1dcbb0aad3720b41a6ade008891b.png][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/c4ef5b88bd5e1dcbb0aad3720b41a6ade008891b.png[/img][/url]

You simply type "[i]boratro[/i]" anywhere in the game to display the tool.

Then you can;
[list]
[*] Change the round
[*] Modify your money
[*] Modify bosses
[*] Refresh shop for free
[*] Modify your deck, add/remove cards
[*] Add/remove curios to your collection
[*] Add/remove essences to your collection
[*] Unlock all playable decks
[*] Immediately win the round
[/list]

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
Slightly changed the money earning balance!
Nerfed the Level Rewards which was getting super high late game.
Buffed the Welcome Reward and Turns Left rewards.
Hopefully, this will allow players to have more money in the early game and more balanced money in the late game. I also think this will add more meaning to the cards and curios which are bulit around earning money.

[h2]NEW BOSSES[/h2]

[url=https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/35d88aba7bfca971a97ad5399841e484fdf83842.png][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/35d88aba7bfca971a97ad5399841e484fdf83842.png[/img][/url]

Added new bosses and polished the boss appearing sequence!
Now we have cool origami bosses that will challenge you every 3rd round.


[h2]INT OVERFLOW[/h2]

People have been making crazy decks and scoring billion points which overflows the max amount and end up scoring negative points.

I FIXED IT! It's not polished yet so you might end up seeing things like this:
[url=https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/928d25127cafc74dd36c62cae4148928ba85d46f.png][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/928d25127cafc74dd36c62cae4148928ba85d46f.png[/img][/url]

Well, thanks everyone for helping out! We are doing really good and once I feel like I fixed enough bugs and the game is solid enough, I'll plan the content for the demo so we'll be ready for the upcoming Steam Festivals!

notes.title: Replicat Playtest Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey Replicatters!
It's been a good week for me. I received lots of bug reports from the community in our discord.
Make sure to join there if you want to have a chat or drop feedback. [url=https://discord.gg/6HMpgT8mXC]Brainoid Discord[/url]

A few youtubers played the game and I see the number of wishlists going up, makes me happy!

I really enjoyed working on the fancy cards. They were hard to read before, now with some cool shaders, we can read what's written on them but also drag them around to see the cool holographic effects.
[previewyoutube=HXmg2IHj_bc;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, we decided to change the visuals of the bosses. They used to be blind drawings of [url=https://www.artstation.com/spacey3d]spacey[/url] where she received some prompts from Twitch chat and drew these illustrations keeping her eyes closed.

They were really funny as an inside joke but people didn't really understand what they were so we are replacing them, they will be missed:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/b7570502c652601b5919acdca8547cf9914d107c.png[/img]

And we are replacing them with Origami Animals! They will fit very well with the paper-style feel of the game. Someone in our community said they liked the bosses being shiny. For now, these origami bosses won't be shiny but I will consider trying them to be shiny and maybe even call them [b]Shinygamis[/b] if that's not gonna violate any Japanese lore lol. So here's a preview of them:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/a114f102f6074e7a36ba6555d624cedb6a5d5dad.png[/img]


I appreciate the help everyone! I'm improving the game day by day and I still need your help to test the game. Because of its depth and the deckbuilding mechanics, there are many many edge cases which are difficult to reproduce by myself. Reach out and report bugs please <3

notes.title: Replicat Playtest Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Thanks a lot for trying out Replicat Playtest version.
I received lots of bug reports on the first day and tried to fix a bunch of em.
It was a cozy snowy day in Istanbul so I enjoyed my bug fixing session today.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45482125/713f59c0627d949c5fc2cf3070151968f9227d8c.png[/img]

If you like the game, please get your friends to try it and make sure to get them wishlist it.
Wishlist are super important for us! <3

Changelog:

+ Fixed curio icons wasn't displaying properly when they get triggered ingame
+ Fixed upgrading cards doesn't immediately upgrade the pair visually
+ Fixed an error where upgrading cards were acually upgrading the card blueprint which wasn't nice.
+ People with different resolutions struggled playing the game. For now, I added letterbox support.
+ Fixed a bug where hovering over a boss reward card was breaking its default position.
+ Fixed curio scroll arrows jumping too far
+ Shellow Man curio now works on the first turn as well
+ Fixed a bug where in win reward items, it was showing html tags like <size>
+ Fixed jokers not copying the behaviour properly when they are the first on the match.
+ Fixed Auto cards and Bottle of Held Breath clashing
+ Fixed essence information not getting reset after use
